blocks.text: 一顆心肝亂操操
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t lia̍p sim-kuann luān tshau tshau

blocks.text: 像是火在燒 水在沖
blocks.spelling: tshin-tshiūnn hué teh sio tsuí teh tsâng

blocks.text: 找不到方法解決 是要叫我怎麼辦
blocks.spelling: tshuē-bôhong-huat liáu-kái sī beh kiò guá an-tsuánn-pān

blocks.text: 一顆心肝結整坨
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t lia̍p sim-kuann kat kui uan

blocks.text: 像是繩子綁緊緊 讓人抓緊緊
blocks.spelling: tshin-tshiūnn soh-á pa̍k ân ân hōo-lâng ê ân ân

blocks.text: 找不到人來幫忙 是要叫我怎麼辦
blocks.spelling: tshuē-bô-lâng lâi tàu-sann-kāng sī beh kiò guá an-tsuánn-pān

blocks.text: 有人為了 沒錢在煩惱
blocks.spelling: ū lâng uī-tio̍h bô tshînn tī ak-tsak

blocks.text: 有人為了 情人不合煩惱
blocks.spelling: ū lâng uī-tio̍h tsîng lâng bē ha̍h ak-tsak

blocks.text: 有人為了 工作在煩惱
blocks.spelling: ū lâng uī-tio̍h khang-khuè tī ak-tsak

blocks.text: 有人為了 家庭吵架煩惱
blocks.spelling: ū lâng uī-tio̍h tshù-lāi uan-ke ak-tsak

blocks.text: 走鐘的人生 跑衝的過程
blocks.spelling: tsáu tsing ê lîn-sing tsáu tshiong ê kuè-tîng

blocks.text: 總是會有不順遂 不要讓人看不起
blocks.spelling: tsóng-sī ē ū bô sūn-suī m̄-thang hōo lâng khuànn-bô-khí

blocks.text: 走鐘的人生 跑衝的過程
blocks.spelling: tsáu tsing ê lîn-sing tsáu tshiong ê kuè-tîng

blocks.text: 總是會有不如意 不要白白來浪費
blocks.spelling: tsóng-sī ē ū put-lû-ì m̄-thang pe̍h-pe̍h lâi lōng-huì

blocks.text: 想要哭 就大聲的哭
blocks.spelling: siūnn-beh khàu tio̍h tuā-siann ka khàu

blocks.text: 哭完 再繼續我們的目標
blocks.spelling: khàu-liáu tsài koh kè-sio̍k lán ê bo̍k-piau
